author_or_org: Qi Liu, Qinzheng Wang, Can Li, Yiming Bie, Wanjing Ma

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: SimSkill consolidates experience into episodic, procedural, and semantic memory.
claims.quote: SimSkill continually identifies capability gaps, generates and solves environment-grounded tasks, verifies solutions through an action--critic loop, and consolidates experience into episodic, procedural, and semantic memory.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Through autonomous exploration, SimSkill builds a library of reusable skills and knowledge spanning major stages of the traffic-simulation workflow.
claims.quote: Through autonomous exploration, it builds a library of reusable skills and knowledge spanning major stages of the traffic-simulation workflow.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: SimSkill illustrates a natural-language-centered design paradigm for LLM-based agent systems, with control logic, operating principles, and accumulated knowledge expressed in natural language.
claims.quote: More broadly, SimSkill illustrates a natural-language-centered design paradigm for LLM-based agent systems. Its high-level control logic, operating principles, and accumulated knowledge are expressed in natural language, while an LLM integrates them with executable tools and code to realize precise and reproducible execution.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: SimSkill was evaluated on two held-out benchmarks across three backbone LLMs, with each result independently verified.
claims.quote: We evaluate SimSkill on two held-out benchmarks across three backbone LLMs, with each result independently verified.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: SimSkill improved verified success by up to 25 percentage points, and ablations showed complementary contributions from procedural and semantic memory.
claims.quote: It improves verified success by up to 25 percentage points, and ablations show complementary contributions from procedural and semantic memory.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: The benefits of SimSkill's memory are backbone- and budget-dependent; memory does not improve every model or uniformly reduce inference cost.
claims.quote: Its benefits remain backbone- and budget-dependent, as memory does not improve every model or uniformly reduce inference cost.
